patterns.note: Extensive use of full-bleed, high-quality photography as background elements for hero sections and content blocks, often with a subtle dark overlay for text contrast.
Content is primarily presented in flexible grid layouts and card-based modules, adapting to different content types like articles, destinations, and tips.
A clear typographic hierarchy with large, bold, sans-serif headings for impact and smaller, highly legible sans-serif for body text and navigation.
A clean, bright palette dominated by white and light blues, accented by a distinct dark green (from the logo) and a vibrant orange/red for highlights and interactive elements.
The hero section features a subtle parallax effect where the main heading scrolls slower than the background image, creating a sense of depth.
A sticky header transforms on scroll, shrinking in height and gaining a solid white background for improved readability against diverse content.
Sections and content cards appear to reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport during scrolling.
Horizontal scrolling carousels (swiper) are used for 'Curated routes' and similar content collections, allowing users to browse multiple items without vertical scrolling.

technique_notes: To rebuild the hero, use a large background image with a semi-transparent dark overlay. Position the main heading text absolutely and apply a scroll-triggered parallax effect, making it move at a slower rate than the background image.

The sticky navigation can be achieved by using CSS position: sticky or a JavaScript scroll listener to add a class that applies a reduced height, solid background, and subtle shadow after a certain scroll threshold.

Content sections and individual cards are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, likely employing CSS keyframes or a JavaScript library to apply a fade-in and slight translate-Y effect as they become visible in the viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body text) create strong visual impact, complemented by clean, legible body text and smaller, often uppercase, labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on image cards and buttons, providing a soft, approachable feel without being overly rounded.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy density, with generous padding around sections and between content cards, contributing to a clean and uncluttered presentation.

standout: The site's standout feature is its masterful use of large, immersive, and aspirational photography as the primary visual language, seamlessly integrated with a clean, card-based content structure and subtle motion. This creates a highly engaging and inspiring user experience that effectively showcases the destination.
